headline: Mona Agarwal Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Mona Agarwal has filed a disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Action Construction Equipment Limited under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a takeover or material shareholding change. The formal disclosure to NSE confirms crossing a regulatory threshold requiring mandatory public notification.
detail: Mona Agarwal submitted a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure when a person or group acquires shares crossing statutory thresholds (typically 25% and multiples thereof). The filing to NSE on 18 June 2026 is the formal declaration of the substantial acquisition event. Further details on consideration, open offer price, and conditions are expected in subsequent regulatory filings.
